scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2 (General States), Chapter 3: ADPs on Pospaces. Globally stable ADPs on partially ordered spaces (Lemma 3.1.1, Theorem 3.1.2, Corollary 3.1.3, Theorem 3.1.4); partially ordered metric spaces, sup-nonexpansive metrics and contracting policy operators (Lemma A.5.21, Theorem 3.1.5); minimization (Theorems 3.1.6-3.1.8); nonstationary policies (Assumption 3.1.1, Lemma 3.1.9, Theorem 3.1.10); bounded measurable functions as a Banach lattice; applications: finite and countable MDPs, Q-factors (Exercises 3.2.1-3.2.6), optimal savings in the strongly and weakly continuous cases (Propositions 3.2.1-3.2.2, Exercise 3.2.7), no-discount optimal stopping (Lemmas 3.2.3-3.2.8, Proposition 3.2.5, Theorem 3.2.9) and sequential analysis (Lemmas 3.2.11-3.2.12, Proposition 3.2.10); with the earlier chapters' models and order theory restated.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2: General States, Chapter 3, pp. 98-122, with the Appendix A results used there.
